title: One-coordinate divergence estimate on Q_δ for C¹ functions
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, n = m + 1, 0 ≤ δ ≤ 1/4, and Q_δ = {z ∈ ℝⁿ : δ < z_j < 1 − δ for all j} ⊆ Euclid n (Lebesgue measure). Let i ∈ Fin n and let e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 be the i-th standard unit vector. For all C¹ functions v, g : ℝⁿ → ℝ with |g(y)| ≤ 1 for all y: |∫_{Q_δ} D(vg)(x)e_i dx| ≤ 4 ∫_{Q_δ} |v| + 2 ∫_{Q_δ} ‖Dv‖, where D denotes the Fréchet derivative (fderiv) and ‖Dv(x)‖ its operator norm.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (v g : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (δ : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 v → ContDiff ℝ 1 g → (∀ y, |g y| ≤ 1) → 0 ≤ δ → δ ≤ 1 / 4 → |∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ j, δ < z j ∧ z j < 1 - δ}, fderiv ℝ (fun y => v y * g y) x (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)| ≤ 4 * (∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ j, δ < z j ∧ z j < 1 - δ}, |v x|) + 2 * ∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ j, δ < z j ∧ z j < 1 - δ}, ‖fderiv ℝ v x‖
